invariants.rationale: The method immediately dereferences profile, so it is expected to be non-null at entry.
The method iterates over profile.getInputPartitionPathStatMap().entrySet(), implying it must not be null.
A Map's size is always non-negative; this can be a useful general invariant.
The method calls getOrDefault on profile.getOutputPartitionPathStatMap(), implying it is non-null.
It is likely that hasOutputWorkLoadStats() returns true iff there is output workload data.
